explicitDestination.behavior: Starts at the canonical route beginning and focuses the visible route h1.

backForward.behavior: Restores valid semantic section, normalized position, visible presentation, and prior in-route focus.

homeRecomposition.behavior: Restores the Core shell first, recomposes current presentation conditions, positions semantically, restores focus, then activates enhancements.

sameRouteMenu.behavior: Consumes the transient menu surface before deferred canonical heading focus; no history entry is added.

sameRouteBagDestination.behavior: Consumes the Bag marker even when the shared same-route handler prevents framework navigation; subsequent Back/Forward does not reopen the Bag.

bagClose.behavior: Back closes the same-document Bag state and restores its actual header or footer invoker.

previewStages.behavior: Contact, Delivery, Review, and terminal remain validated same-URL history states and focus the active stage heading.

supersededIntent.behavior: Bag or menu intent replaces an uncommitted route intent, restores the captured source semantic context without stealing overlay focus, and retains the active surface.
